messages:
maria (marketing): Heads-up  I uploaded the final draft for the product post (Drive link). Need quick approvals: publish time, hero copy, CTA variants, and lead-routing.

alex (growth): Prefer Fri 9am PT so PR can prep outreach. Also want an influencer preview 48h before public.

rishi (product): Friday works. Confirming benchmark snapshot: ~36% unit-cost reduction and 2.3x median latency improvement vs our baseline. Legal needs a methodology link.

taylor (growthops): HubSpot routing proposal: blog->list:launch_optimize_2026; webinar signups->tag:webinar_early; clicks on benchmark CTA->workflow:nurture_bench. Add utm params: utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_2026&utm_medium=web.

kate (legal): Reviewed claims. Please add this footnote exactly: "Benchmarks run on Redwood eval-suite; representative workloads only. Methodology: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/optimize-2026" Also: add "Used with permission" under any partner quote. No absolutes (avoid "always", "zero").

sam (design): Need final hero image (1200x630) and two CTA button styles. Uploaded image drafts v5 & v6. Alt text proposals in Drive.

maria (marketing): Draft hero lines: A) "Reduce inference cost 36% with Redwood Optimize" B) "2.3x faster median latency in our benchmark" Which headline should be default?

alex (growth): A/B headliner test for first 10k visitors: headlineA=cost, headlineB=latency. Email subject test too: subjA="Cut inference costs 36%" subjB="See 2.3x faster LLM responses". Add `?utm_experiment=headlineA` on variant A.

taylor (growthops): HubSpot experiment mapping: experiment=headline_test; assign `webinar_early` subflow for registrants; route leads with interest tag -> `sales_priority:high` when role matches "platform" or "infra".

rishi (product): Landing page will include a short methodology excerpt and a link to the full appendix. I'll paste the one-paragraph summary into the doc in 10m.

kate (legal): Approved the partner quote from BetaSystems; please include "Quote used with permission. See Doc #9204" under the quote.

publish-bot: Publish checklist status -> missing: final hero quote (50	65 chars), hero alt text confirmation, OG image file name. Run `/schedule publish 2026-05-07T16:00Z` after checklist complete.

maria (marketing): Hero quote candidate (58 chars): "Optimize inference: faster responses, lower unit cost." Tightening language a bit. Also planning embargoed influencer preview on Wed 9am PT.

alex (growth): For influencers: short preview email + one-click opt-in link (track via `utm_partner=influencer`) and NDA toggle. I'll compile the list.

taylor (growthops): I'll create an internal preview URL (password-protected) and set the embargo meta header. Also will verify HubSpot forms in staging and toggle the experiment flag.

sam (design): Confirmed OG file: `optimize-hero-v5.png` uploaded to assets/redwood/optimize/. Alt text set to: "dashboard showing latency and cost improvements".

kate (legal): :thumbsup: on hero quote phrasing. Confirm NDA is required for influencer preview? We prefer an opt-in with consent; legal suggests link to partner terms.

rishi (product): One small ask: include a short bulleted FAQ on the landing page addressing common perf questions. I'll drop bullets into the doc.

maria (marketing): Final checklist for tomorrow: 1) hero quote locked 2) OG image and alt confirmed 3) HubSpot routing tested 4) subject/headline experiments configured 5) influencer list + preview prepared. Please :thumbsup: if green.

alex (growth): :thumbsup:
taylor (growthops): :thumbsup:
sam (design): :thumbsup:
kate (legal): :thumbsup:
rishi (product): :thumbsup:
maria (marketing): Great  locking embargo and publish once checklist is all green. Will run `/schedule publish` when done.
